features.label: Exclusive miami j select compatibility
features.text: Designed specifically to fit the universal sizing of the Ossur Miami J Select cervical collar. Please note that these pads are not compatible with standard Miami J models or other brands.

features.label: Advanced antimicrobial protection
features.text: Protect your skin health during long-term use. The proprietary Sorbatex padding actively inhibits over 99 percent of microbial growth to keep your neck brace fresh and odor-free.

features.label: Rapid drying technology
features.text: Avoid the discomfort of a damp collar against your neck. This advanced material dries over 30 percent faster than traditional cotton or foam padding, making your daily wash rotation simple and efficient.

features.label: Foolproof color coded design
features.text: Easily install your fresh pads without second-guessing. The intuitive dual-color system uses a grey side that grips securely to the collar hooks and a soft blue side that rests comfortably against your skin.

measurement: Universal one-size pad set. Designed exclusively to fit all Miami J Select cervical collars. Perfect Fit Promise
